description: Ledgerly is online invoicing software for small businesses and freelancers. Create branded invoices in seconds, accept card and bank payments, and let automatic reminders follow up on late payments so you get paid faster without awkward emails.
features: Branded invoice templates with your logo and colours
Automatic payment reminders on a schedule you choose
Card, bank transfer and Apple Pay checkout on every invoice
Recurring invoices for retainers and subscriptions
Multi-currency invoicing with live exchange rates
Cash-flow dashboard showing what is due, paid and overdue
audiences: Small agencies with a few clients on retainer
Local service businesses such as plumbers and cleaners
Accountants who manage invoicing for clients
